answers.core: It is a small quality of life feature that enables missing functionality.
answers.workaround: You can not replicate the functionality of a link like that as far as I know. But you can just write `[code]CustomClass[/code]` instead and leave it to the other programmer to find it through the doc search.

title: Add `[class Class]` BBCode to documentation to allow linking directly to `class_name` of a custom class
